get_data: read a JSON file of DFT and force field data and split into CO2 and H2O lists
binned_average: compute the average prediction error within each bin of DFT adsorption energy values
get_Fig4a: generate a histogram of raw force field minus DFT error for CO2 and H2O
get_Fig4b: plot binned average error and KDE density of DFT interaction energy for CO2 and H2O
phys_err: calculate the mean absolute error for physisorption points where DFT energy is between 0 and -0.5 eV
